extracted.name: Quick and Easy Parmesan Zucchini Fries
extracted.description: These baked Parmesan zucchini fries are flavored with paprika, garlic, and mixed herbs. Easy to make, and carb-conscious as well!
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds zucchinis, cut into 1/2-inch French fry strips
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Whisk eggs in a shallow bowl. Combine Parmesan cheese, mixed herbs, garlic powder, paprika, and pepper in a separate shallow bowl; mix well.
Dip zucchini fries into beaten eggs, in batches; shake to remove excess, and roll in Parmesan mixture until fully coated. Place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven, turning once, until golden and crispy, 30 to 35 minutes.
